subject: Multi-slot partner demo: triage, shadow-host & fallback windows
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Multi-slot partner demo: triage, shadow-host & fallback windows

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. We want to lock the public-facing joint demo for CloudBridge + Redwood, but given APAC attendees and AWS SI involvement there are a few moving parts. To keep things simple, proposing three candidate windows (all PT):

- Option A: Tue Aug 25 09:00–10:00 PT (primary) — AWS SI (Paul) can join live
- Option B: Wed Aug 26 17:00–18:00 PT (evening slot for US/EMEA overlap) — backup if A conflicts
- Option C: Thu Aug 27 00:00–01:00 PT (APAC-friendly micro-window) — dry-run / replay slot

Can you confirm which slot works for CloudBridge engineering + your customer champion? Also:
- Do you want us to include NexPhase (SI) on the panel? Paul from AWS indicated he can join but needs final confirmation.
- We recommend designating a shadow-host from Redwood to field infra cutovers / breaks (I’ve cc’d Karthik to propose).
- I attached the current runbook and the deck for the joint demo; if you have a customer-specific slide, send it back and we’ll fold it in.

Attachments:
[Attachment: demo_runbook_v2.pdf (PDF, 132KB)]
[Attachment: product_deck_redwood_v3.pptx (PPTX, 4.3MB)]

If none of the three slots work, please send two alternatives and we’ll attempt to keep the AWS SI and NexPhase aligned. Once we have a slot I’ll send a calendar invite and short run-of-show.

Thanks — appreciate the flexibility.

— Olga
Olga Petrov
Partner Solutions 
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0198
From: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@cloudbridge.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Paul Thomas <paul.thomas@aws-sis.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Multi-slot partner demo: triage, shadow-host & fallback windows

Hi Olga —

Thanks — passing this to the CloudBridge engineering lead (cc’d offline) but quick notes:
- Option A (Tue Aug 25 09:00 PT) conflicts with a customer steering call we can’t move.
- Option B (Wed Aug 26 17:00 PT) looks promising for our EU/US stakeholders but I need to confirm with our APAC rep — will know by Monday.
- Option C (Thu Aug 27 00:00 PT) is doable only as a rehearsal; we’d prefer not to make it the main session.

Paul (cc) from AWS SI: can you confirm availability for Wed Aug 26 17:00 PT? If not, suggest Tue Aug 25 11:00 PT as a narrow alternate (still PT).

Also: we need a brief ops checklist for the runbook that explains fallback if the SI cannot join live (three-line summary), and whether Redwood can host the recording and make it available internally for 48 hours.

Thanks — I’ll follow up Monday with final attendee list.

Best,
Samantha Reed
Head of Partnerships
CloudBridge Solutions
samantha.reed@cloudbridge.com
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@cloudbridge.com>, Paul Thomas <paul.thomas@aws-sis.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Multi-slot partner demo: triage, shadow-host & fallback windows

Thanks Samantha — appreciate the quick read.

We’ll tentatively hold Option B (Wed Aug 26 17:00 PT) for the public demo and keep Option A as a nearby alternate (Tue Aug 25 11:00 PT if AWS SI confirms). Option C will be used as a dry-run only.

Quick answers to your asks:
- Ops checklist: I added a one‑page fallback section to the runbook (see link below) — covers SI absence, network blip recovery steps, and who to page for infra fallback.
- Recording: Redwood can host the recording for 72 hours and provide a secure link (we’ll redact any PII on request).

Karthik — can you serve as shadow-host and take the break-glass fallback (handle infra handoff, start the recording, and be ready to flip to a cached model instance if we hit a runtime GPU outage)? If yes I’ll add you to the calendar as co-host and include your short ops checklist in the runbook.

Links: 
- Runbook (with fallback section): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-demo-runbook
- Proposed calendar hold: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=4gh5ij

If that works I’ll: 1) create the invite, 2) add Paul as a presenter placeholder, and 3) share the recording retention notes in the invite description.

— Olga

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 13:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Multi-slot partner demo: triage, shadow-host & fallback windows

I can take shadow-host duties for the public session on Wed Aug 26 17:00 PT. Notes for the runbook (ops handoff):
- I’ll be primary pager for infra issues (pager: @karthik_ops).
- If AWS SI does not join within first 8 minutes, I’ll switch to the cached-quantized model path and announce on the Webex channel.
- I’ll confirm recording start within the first 2 minutes and ensure the link is generated to the shared folder.

Attachments:
[Attachment: ops_checklist.txt (TXT, 3KB)]

I’ll be on standby Tue Aug 25 11:00 PT as a buffer if AWS wants to move earlier. Adding Kimberly so she can help field customer-facing Q&A.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@cloudbridge.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Paul Thomas <paul.thomas@aws-sis.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Multi-slot partner demo: triage, shadow-host & fallback windows

Perfect — thanks everyone. Wed Aug 26 17:00 PT confirmed from our side; Paul confirmed offline as well.

Please add a 15-minute preflight on the invite for 16:45 PT (tech check + quick run-of-show). We’ll share the final attendee list and any customer slides by EOD Thursday.

Looking forward to it — appreciate the clear fallback plans.

Best,
Samantha
Head of Partnerships
CloudBridge Solutions
